title: Morning by Morning He Awakens
description: Before we speak into the day, Isaiah 50 offers a quieter gift — an ear awakened by God, ready to hear mercy and learn trust.
scripture: Isaiah 50:4

title: Satisfy Us in the Morning
description: Before the day asks for productivity, Psalm 90 asks for something deeper — a heart filled with God’s steadfast love at dawn.
scripture: Psalm 90:14

title: Let Me Hear in the Morning
description: Before the day fills with noise, Psalm 143 asks for one first word — God’s steadfast love spoken into the quiet of dawn.
scripture: Psalm 143:8

title: Come and Have Breakfast
description: At daybreak by the sea, Jesus welcomes tired disciples with a fire, a meal, and a mercy that arrives before they have a plan.
scripture: John 21:12

title: While It Was Still Dark
description: Mary comes to the tomb before sunrise — and finds that Jesus meets us in the grey hour when hope still feels unfinished.
scripture: John 20:1

title: New Every Morning
description: Before the day fills up, a quiet word from Lamentations — mercies that do not run out, and a Savior who meets us at dawn.
scripture: Lamentations 3:22–23

title: Stay With Us
description: Evening light on the Emmaus road — recognition, burning hearts, and the joy of remaining with the risen Jesus.

title: Take My Yoke
description: Midday rest for the weary — Jesus’ invitation in Matthew 11 to exchange our heavy loads for His gentle yoke.
scripture: Matthew 11:28–30

title: Come and See
description: Jesus’ gentle invitation in John 1 — curiosity, encounter, and the beginning of discipleship.
scripture: John 1:39

title: Abide in Me
description: A longer reading of John 14–15 — Jesus’ words of peace, the way to the Father, and the call to abide in the vine.
scripture: John 14–15

title: Blessed Are You
description: A longer reading of Matthew 5 — Jesus begins the Sermon on the Mount with blessing, light, and a love that reaches even our enemies.
scripture: Matthew 5

title: Lost and Found
description: A longer reading of Luke 15 — Jesus’ three parables of the lost sheep, the lost coin, and the waiting father.
scripture: Luke 15

title: The Sermon on the Mount
description: Matthew 5–7 in the World English Bible — Jesus’ long teaching on the blessed life, prayer, worry, and the house built on rock.
scripture: Matthew 5–7

title: The Good Shepherd
description: A longer reading of John 10 — Jesus the door and the good shepherd who knows His sheep by name.
scripture: John 10

title: Completely Different on a Beach in Guinea
description: In Conakry, Guinea, a chance beach meeting led Vennico from Islam and a reckless life to faith in Jesus — baptism, discipleship, and a dream to plant a church near Sierra Leone. Source: International Mission Board (Chris Doyle), Beach encounter in Guinea becomes discipleship journey (CC BY-NC 4.0)
scripture: 2 Corinthians 5:17

title: It Is Your Choice, Sarah
description: A young woman’s 21st-century turn — rebellion at university, a whisper of mercy, and faith that held even while she was dying of cancer (Sarah’s last message, public domain via Barnabas Aid). Source: Sarah’s last message, shared by Barnabas Aid (released to the public domain)
scripture: John 10:10

title: The Painter Who Believed the Story
description: In South Asia, an artist commissioned to paint the biblical creation story came to faith in Jesus while working — and became the first known believer from his people group. Source: International Mission Board (Jude and Rocky Brown), First person: God used a painting to draw a man to Him (CC BY-NC 4.0)
scripture: Romans 10:9

title: Take Up and Read
description: Augustine’s conversion in a Milan garden — a child’s chant, an open page of Paul, and the end of long delay (Confessions Book VIII). Source: Augustine, Confessions VIII (E. B. Pusey translation, public domain)
scripture: Romans 13:13–14

title: Philippians 4:6-7
description: When worry will not let you rest
scripture: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

title: John 14:27
description: When your heart will not settle
scripture: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

title: Isaiah 41:10
description: When you are afraid and dismayed
scripture: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

title: Psalm 23:4
description: When you walk through the valley
scripture: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

title: Psalm 34:18
description: When your heart is broken
scripture: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

title: Deuteronomy 31:8
description: When you feel left on your own
scripture: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.

title: Psalm 68:6
description: When loneliness has a name
scripture: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

title: Matthew 11:28
description: When you are worn out and heavy-laden
scripture: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

title: Isaiah 40:31
description: When you have no strength left to run
scripture: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

title: 2 Corinthians 12:9
description: When weakness feels like the last word
scripture: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

title: Mark 9:24
description: When belief and unbelief sit together
scripture: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

title: Romans 8:1
description: When shame keeps repeating your name
scripture: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

title: 1 John 1:9
description: When you cannot hide what you have done
scripture: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

title: Psalm 27:14
description: When the waiting has grown long
scripture: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

title: James 5:14-15
description: When the body is sick
scripture: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord, and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

title: Matthew 6:31-33
description: When provision feels uncertain
scripture: Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’ For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things. But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

title: Hebrews 13:5
description: When money is tight and you feel alone
scripture: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

title: Psalm 34:4
description: When fears have multiplied
scripture: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

title: Psalm 46:1
description: When trouble comes close
scripture: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

title: 2 Corinthians 1:3-4
description: When you need comfort you can pass on
scripture: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

title: 1 Peter 5:7
description: When you wonder if anyone cares
scripture: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

title: 2 Timothy 1:7
description: When fear has taken the lead
scripture: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

title: Psalm 55:22
description: When the load is too heavy to carry
scripture: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

title: Romans 8:38-39
description: When you fear you have gone too far
scripture: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: John 14:1
description: When trouble crowds the room
scripture: Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

title: John 16:33
description: When the world feels like too much
scripture: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.

title: Lamentations 3:22-23
description: When you thought mercy had run out
scripture: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

title: Proverbs 3:5-6
description: When you cannot see the path
scripture: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

title: Psalm 147:3
description: When body or spirit is wounded
scripture: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

title: John 14:18
description: When you feel abandoned
scripture: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

title: Matthew 5:4
description: When mourning will not lift
scripture: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

title: John 16:22
description: When sorrow is still heavy
scripture: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

title: Psalm 119:50
description: When only His word can revive you
scripture: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

title: Isaiah 51:12
description: When human threats loom large
scripture: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?”

title: Joshua 1:9
description: When you need courage for the next step
scripture: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.

title: John 20:27
description: When doubt asks to touch the wounds
scripture: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

title: Psalm 73:26
description: When flesh and heart are failing
scripture: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

title: Isaiah 54:4
description: When shame still has your name
scripture: Don’t be afraid; for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded; for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth; and the reproach of your widowhood you shall remember no more.

title: Psalm 34:5
description: When you need a face that is not ashamed
scripture: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

title: Philippians 4:19
description: When supply feels uncertain
scripture: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

title: 1 Timothy 6:6-8
description: When enough feels hard to believe
scripture: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out. But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

title: Psalm 103:2-3
description: When you need healing remembered
scripture: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits; who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

title: Jeremiah 17:14
description: When you ask to be healed and saved
scripture: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

title: Lamentations 3:25-26
description: When waiting is the work
scripture: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

title: Psalm 130:5
description: When your soul waits for His word
scripture: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

description: Jesus [is] the king of my heart.

description: I put believer first, because that is supposed to be the roots of everything that I do…

title: Steph Curry (2015)
description: …point them towards the Man who died for our sins on the cross.

description: Now that I'm in service to Christ, my job is to spread the gospel… I'm no longer a slave, I'm a son now, a son of God.

title: Chance the Rapper (2019)
description: It changed my life for real and now I know exactly where my strength comes from…

title: Chance the Rapper (2019)
description: My understanding of a lot of stuff is based on Jesus.

description: God was using my ego to draw me to Him.

description: I'm so grateful to be surrendered in Christ.

description: I had to find what worked for me and I found that Jesus worked for me.

title: Kathy Ireland (2023)

title: Denzel Washington (2017)
description: I'm unashamed and unafraid to share it!

title: Denzel Washington (2017)
description: It is so difficult to trust that Jesus died for our sins because the mind never shuts off… We know, but we forget constantly, moment by moment.

title: Jelly Roll (2025)

title: Mark Wahlberg (2022)
description: Jesus didn't come to save the righteous, He came to save the sinners. We're all weak.

title: Tim Tebow (2016)
description: I'm so thankful because of my relationship with Jesus Christ and being adopted in the family of God… My identity lies as a child of God, and that's something that will never be shaken.

title: Kelsey Grammer (2025)
description: I'm not going to deny that I have faith and I'm a follower of Jesus.

title: Carrie Underwood (2021)
description: I feel like the answer to all of our problems is Jesus.
